# Cover generation record

Generated on 2026-10-31 with Codex's built-in ImageGen tool. No API/CLI fallback was used. The final original output is stored unchanged as `cover.png` (1983 × 793). The application icon is unchanged.

Apple's [MacBook Air specifications](https://www.apple.com/macbook-air/specs/) supplied geometry references only: its right-side diagram and frontal product view. Those reference photographs are not redistributed in this repository. The accepted illustration shows a single headphone socket on the visible right side; the opposite left-side ports are outside the view. This is decorative generated artwork, not an app screenshot, telemetry, device qualification or an Apple endorsement.

The final image and an enlarged inspection of its right side were visually checked before publication. Earlier outputs with extra right-side holes were rejected and are not publication assets. Original repository-artwork licensing applies.

## Final prompt

```text
Use case: product-mockup. Generate a completely NEW original wide 2.5:1 product illustration for Tilvero README. Reference image 1 is ONLY the MacBook Air RIGHT side engineering geometry: perfectly plain silver sidewall with ONE round headphone socket. Reference image 2 is ONLY general MacBook Air display/keyboard proportions. Fresh scene: open silver 13-inch M5 MacBook Air, laptop centered and occupying most of wide composition, photographed slightly from the user's right, showing the thin right sidewall distinctly and clearly. A small translucent green sculptural battery sits to its left. Pure white seamless studio, graphite details, vibrant system green original abstract screen wallpaper. Air has flat uniform thin aluminum body, black keyboard without speaker grilles, large trackpad, black display bezel with centered camera notch. CRITICAL PHYSICAL DETAIL: the visible right sidewall must look exactly like reference 1, with precisely ONE black circular 3.5mm headphone socket near the back hinge. One circle only; all aluminum forward of it and behind it is completely smooth, blank silver. DO NOT DUPLICATE THE JACK. NO additional black dots, holes, screws, USB-C, MagSafe, oval slots, vents or speaker holes anywhere on the visible right flank. Other ports are on the opposite left side and not seen in this view. Make right sidewall wide enough and sharply focused to visibly count the solitary socket. Realistic precision geometry and soft premium studio materials. White/graphite/clean bright system-green palette matching native macOS UI, no beige cast. No text, logos, branding, typography, fake app UI or numerical telemetry. Original generated artwork, not a copy of the Apple photo. Completely new framing/composition, no reuse of any prior generated scene.
```
